name: setup
summary: Configure docker-dev for the current project.
help:
Configures docker-dev for the current project. After explicit confirmation, it creates or updates .docker-dev, lets you select plugins recursively, configures published ports, and configures the selected runtimes.

The setup also configures direnv on the host: it installs direnv when necessary, adds one managed hook to the current shell's startup file, creates the managed .envrc entrypoint, and authorizes it. It never replaces an existing unmanaged .envrc.

Finally, docker-dev starts the development container, installs the declared asdf runtimes and runs enabled post-asdf plugin hooks. Open a new terminal after setup so the direnv hook is available.
